description: Entities and relationships of Morocco's AI ecosystem, each tied to records in evidence.json. Chain: Institution → Initiative → Project → Evidence → Technology → Sector.

entity_types.institution: A public body, university, research centre, regulator, business association or international organisation.
entity_types.initiative: A national strategy, roadmap or programme.
entity_types.event: A dated gathering at which documented acts took place.
entity_types.project: A specific institute, agreement, platform or product created under or alongside an initiative.
entity_types.technology: A technology family named by a source as the focus of a project.
entity_types.sector: An economic or public-policy sector a source names as targeted.

domains.infrastructure-sovereignty: Infrastructure, computing capacity and data sovereignty

domain_labels_ar.infrastructure-sovereignty: البنية التحتية والقدرة الحاسوبية والسيادة على البيانات

entities.name: Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform
alt_names: Ministère de la Transition Numérique et de la Réforme de l'Administration
entities.summary: The government department that launched Digital Morocco 2030 in September 2024, organised the First National AI Conference in July 2025 and presented the Morocco AI 2030 roadmap in September 2026.
entities.status: Named in sources up to September 2026. See the note on the October 2026 government.
entities.note: The government appointed on 16 October 2026 includes a Minister of Artificial Intelligence, Digital Transformation and Administration Reform. The registry has not yet verified whether that ministry takes over this department's portfolio.

entities.name: Ministry of Artificial Intelligence, Digital Transformation and Administration Reform
entities.summary: A ministerial portfolio created with the government appointed on 16 October 2026. It is the first Moroccan ministry with artificial intelligence in its title in this registry's sources.
entities.note: Its legal attributions had not been published in a source retrieved by the registry as of the as-of date.

entities.name: Ministry of Industry and Commerce
alt_names: Ministère de l'Industrie et du Commerce
entities.summary: Signatory of the March 2026 convention creating the JAZARI Industrie X.0 institute.

entities.name: Ministry of Economy and Finance
alt_names: Ministère de l'Economie et des Finances
entities.summary: Signatory of the March 2026 convention creating the JAZARI Industrie X.0 institute.

entities.name: Ministry of Higher Education, Scientific Research and Innovation
entities.summary: Party to the July 2025 memorandum of understanding on an Al Jazari Institute in the Province of Nador.

entities.name: Ministry of Energy Transition and Sustainable Development
entities.summary: Party to a July 2025 agreement on sustainable and sovereign digital infrastructure (green data centres).

entities.name: Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P)
entities.summary: University that created the AI Movement research centre in March 2021, and signed a data-centre partnership convention at the July 2025 National AI Conference.

entities.name: AI Movement — International Center for Artificial Intelligence of Morocco
alt_names: Centre international d'intelligence artificielle du Maroc
entities.summary: Research and development centre created by UM6P in March 2021. UNESCO reports that it was established as a Category 2 Centre under UNESCO auspices through a tripartite agreement with the Government of Morocco.

entities.name: Euro-Mediterranean University of Fès
entities.summary: One of the four Fès-Meknès universities that signed the JAZARI Industrie X.0 convention in March 2026.

entities.name: Sidi Mohammed Ben Abdellah University, Fès
entities.summary: One of the four Fès-Meknès universities that signed the JAZARI Industrie X.0 convention in March 2026.

entities.name: Moulay Ismail University, Meknès
entities.summary: One of the four Fès-Meknès universities that signed the JAZARI Industrie X.0 convention in March 2026.

entities.name: Al Akhawayn University in Ifrane
entities.summary: One of the four Fès-Meknès universities that signed the JAZARI Industrie X.0 convention in March 2026.

entities.name: General Confederation of Moroccan Enterprises (CGEM)
alt_names: Confédération Générale des Entreprises du Maroc
entities.summary: Private-sector confederation whose president signed the constitutive convention of the Institut Jazari ROOT public-interest group in January 2026.

entities.name: UNESCO
alt_names: United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization
entities.summary: Intergovernmental organisation under whose auspices AI Movement was established as a Category 2 Centre.

entities.name: National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection (CNDP)
alt_names: Commission Nationale de contrôle de la protection des Données à caractère Personnel
entities.summary: Morocco's personal-data protection authority, which publishes Law 09-08 as the reference text of its mandate.

entities.name: Digital Morocco 2030
entities.summary: National digital strategy launched on 25 September 2024. Its official targets include 240,000 direct jobs in 2030 and a rise from 113th to 50th place in the e-government development index.

entities.name: Morocco AI 2030
entities.summary: National AI roadmap presented by the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform. It is built on three pillars and relies on the JAZARI Institutes network. Its official 2030 targets are MAD 100 billion in added value to GDP, 50,000 jobs and 200,000 certified AI talents.
entities.status: Under implementation according to the ministry (September 2026). Targets run to 2030.

entities.name: JAZARI Institutes network
entities.summary: Network of AI institutes of excellence that the ministry describes as the operational arm of Morocco AI 2030 for research and innovation. It was announced as covering the twelve regions, with JAZARI ROOT as its core.
entities.status: Announced in January 2026. Signed founding instruments are documented for JAZARI ROOT and JAZARI Industrie X.0.

entities.name: First National AI Conference (Assises nationales de l'IA)
entities.summary: Two-day national conference held in Rabat on 1–2 July 2025 and organised by the Ministry of Digital Transition. Several agreements were signed there, including on an Al Jazari Institute in Nador, green data centres and a UM6P data-centre partnership.

entities.name: Institut Jazari ROOT
entities.summary: Public-interest group (GIP) that is the technical and strategic core of the JAZARI network. Its themes are e-government, smart rural and mountain zones, and major sporting events. CGEM and several ministerial departments signed its constitutive convention on 12 January 2026.

entities.name: JAZARI Industrie X.0
entities.summary: Al-Jazari institute for smart industry, created by a convention signed in Fès on 10 March 2026 by three ministries and the four universities of the Fès-Meknès region. Its stated focus is AI, the Internet of Things, advanced robotics and industrial data analytics.

entities.name: JAZARI Smart City
entities.summary: Named by the ministry in September 2026 as one of the components of the JAZARI Institutes network.
entities.status: Named only. No founding instrument documented in the registry.

entities.name: JAZARI EduTech
entities.summary: Named by the ministry in September 2026 as one of the components of the JAZARI Institutes network.
entities.status: Named only. No founding instrument documented in the registry.

entities.name: Al Jazari Institute, Province of Nador
entities.summary: Institute dedicated to AI research, training and innovation in the Province of Nador. A memorandum of understanding for it was co-signed at the July 2025 National AI Conference.
entities.status: Memorandum of understanding signed July 2025. Operational status not verified.

entities.name: Sovereign green data-centre infrastructure agreement
entities.summary: Agreement signed at the July 2025 National AI Conference with the Ministry of Energy Transition and Sustainable Development, on sustainable, high-performing and sovereign digital infrastructure (green data centres).
entities.status: Agreement signed July 2025. No facility documented.

entities.name: UM6P data-centre partnership convention
entities.summary: Convention signed with UM6P at the July 2025 National AI Conference to formalise a strategic partnership on data centres, research, innovation, training and digital sovereignty.

entities.name: Sovereign AI marketplace
entities.summary: Platform unveiled by the ministry in September 2026, intended to give access to secure and trusted AI solutions with data protection and infrastructure control in Morocco.
entities.status: Presented September 2026. Public availability not verified.

entities.name: Idarati AI
entities.summary: Agentic AI assistant presented in September 2026, intended to inform, guide and assist users with administrative procedures.
entities.status: Presented September 2026. Public availability not verified.

entities.name: Law 09-08 on personal data protection
entities.summary: Morocco's personal data protection law, published by the CNDP as the reference text of its mandate.
entities.status: In force. Promulgation references not yet recorded (see evidence note).

relationships.subject: first-national-ai-conference-2025
relationships.note: The synthesis report says the conference laid the foundation of Morocco's "future National Artificial Intelligence roadmap". The ministry later presented Morocco AI 2030 as the national AI strategy. Treating them as the same roadmap is TheMoroccoAI's inference; no source retrieved states it in those words.

relationships.subject: jazari-institute-nador
relationships.note: The Nador institute carries the Al Jazari name and predates the network announcement. The September 2026 list of network components does not mention it, so membership in the network is not established.

relationships.subject: ministry-higher-education
relationships.note: The source says the memorandum "also involv[es]" this ministry; the exact signatory role is not detailed.

relationships.subject: unesco
relationships.note: Designation as a UNESCO Category 2 Centre.
